You set the bone, close the tear, and talk them through the part where it hurts.

Rules

Action

Target / range / shape
One willing creature with a Soft Tissue or Bone wound.
Duration
The treatment.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand and basic treatment tools.
Limits
One attempt per wound per day, as normal treatment.
Type
Signature
Weak
2 progress.
Standard
3 progress.
Strong
5 progress, and reduce one temporary condition caused by the wound by 1. This counts as the wound's one treatment attempt for the day. You can do it without a treatment kit; steady hands and a quiet word substitute for tools. It does not remove the wound outright, restore HP, or erase a scar.
